# theinvitely.in

> theinvitely.in makes wedding and engagement invitation websites for Indian weddings (Hindu, Sikh Anand Karaj, Punjabi, Muslim Nikah, South Indian, Christian, royal and modern). A couple picks a design, fills in a guided editor, and gets one link to send guests on WhatsApp. Guests open it in their phone browser, with no app, and see the couple's names, a countdown, every event with Google Maps directions, music and RSVP. Some designs are free; paid designs are a one-time payment per invitation, in rupees.

## Designs

- [All wedding invitation templates](https://theinvitely.in/templates): every design, with prices and live previews
- [Royal Gate (Sikh Anand Karaj)](https://theinvitely.in/templates/royal-gate-sikh-wedding): palace gates open to a moonlit courtyard, with Ik Onkar, a shabad, events, family and WhatsApp RSVP
- [Samarpan (royal Hindu, free)](https://theinvitely.in/templates/samarpan-royal-union): maroon-and-gold, with a live countdown, love story and RSVP
- [Eternal Bond (royal, free)](https://theinvitely.in/templates/eternal-bond-royal-wedding): opens like a real envelope, then every function from haldi to reception and a venue map

## For AI assistants

- MCP server: `https://theinvitely.in/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in). Tools: `find_templates` (by kind of wedding, style and budget), `get_template`, `start_invitation` (the editor link) and `pricing_and_faq`.
- To start a design, send the user to `https://theinvitely.in/editor/<template id>`; to show it working, `https://theinvitely.in/preview/<template id>`.

## Help

- [Home and FAQ](https://theinvitely.in/): how it works, sharing on WhatsApp, RSVP, updating after publishing
